apps/wallpaper.reason: Native mutation activation and cancellation-safe process/container isolation have not been qualified for this new workspace. Ordinary test coverage does not establish mutation support.

limitations.reason: Node, jsdom and page-owned Vitest Chromium projects are configured in one native per-test stage. jsdom and Chromium activation remain pending qualification under #519; configuration alone does not establish support. Image Worker globals lack verified activation and per-test coverage transport and remain excluded under #520.

apps/web-e2e.reason: Deployed Playwright journeys load separately served application bundles without native Vitest mutant activation, per-test coverage or result transport. The workspace's Node configuration tests do not qualify browser journeys. Supporting them requires owned instrumented serving, browser activation and native selected-test/result transport.

packages/biome-test-rules.reason: Biome plugins execute in an isolated runtime; CLI subprocesses and the Node algorithm contracts have no validated native Vitest mutation activation.

packages/core.reason: The unit database health probe opens an unowned localhost:59999 PostgreSQL endpoint. Control this external input before enabling mutations. Integration container ownership/reset and subprocess activation also remain unvalidated.

limitations.reason: The existing jsdom suites are configured for native per-test mutation analysis; activation remains pending qualification under #519. jsdom does not establish real Muuri layout or Chromium behavior.

packages/test-utils.reason: Container fixture implementation requires separate multi-family isolation and activation validation; ordinary E2E coverage is insufficient.

packages/testcontainers.reason: Container/reaper suites include child processes whose mutation activation is unvalidated.

packages/url-ipv4-resolver.reason: The resolver suite uses live DNS for example.com; deterministic resolver inputs must be validated before repeated mutation execution.

packages/vitest-config.reason: Shared configuration only; invalidate all dependent suites instead of claiming a standalone score.
